subject: OakBridge activation preflight — owner assignment & blockers
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Matthew Cole <matthew.cole@oakbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OakBridge activation preflight — owner assignment & blockers

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Quick handoff note for OakBridge Health — SOW has been signed (attached). Goal is a production-ready rollout for 25 pilot clinicians by 2026-10-15 with a staged expansion in Q4. High-level context:

- Commercial: 12-month term; committed throughput target ~200 qps during peak clinical workflows.
- Deployment: Customer opted for Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) in us-west for latency + data isolation.
- Data: We'll ingest mapping CSVs via SFTP; customer will share a de-identified training sample.
- Security: OakBridge requires SOC 2 evidence and KMS integration for key rotation. Legal will send a small privacy addendum.

Key asks for CS:
1) Who will be the primary CS/implementation owner (we need a single point of contact for go/no-go checks)?
2) Confirm the kickoff slot window — proposing Mon 2026-09-22 10:00 PT for a 60-min technical kickoff and milestone alignment.
3) Preflight checklist: environment access, API keys for a test account, sample payloads, and acceptance criteria. I attached the signed SOW and a preflight template to populate before kickoff.

Risks / known blockers:
- Customer has an internal legal review outstanding (shouldn't block kickoff but may change timeline for production keys).
- They want an explicit SLA on median latency for inference under 200ms — we'll need ops involvement to confirm the Dedicated pool sizing.

Naomi, would you be able to own the implementation and coordinate the kickoff? Marissa — please shadow as the CSM on the account. Aditya, feel free to add any technical clarifications below.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Subject: Re: OakBridge activation preflight — owner assignment & blockers

Thanks Jonas — happy to own this.

A few clarifying questions before we lock the kickoff:
- Is the Dedicated cluster already provisioned or should we expect a ~2 week lead time for GPU pool allocation? (That will affect our go-live target.)
- For the SOC 2 request: do they want our SOC 2 report uploaded to a shared portal or will they accept an Attestation + the SOC 2 Type II PDF? I can loop in Security if needed.
- Do we have their expected QPS broken down by endpoint (chat vs. embeddings batch jobs)? The preflight template asks for typical and peak queries to size batching and autoscale policies.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) I will schedule the kickoff and put together a 30-min ops + infra pre-read (environment access + deliverables).
2) Marissa — please confirm customer success contact(s) on OakBridge side (who will own user acceptance).
3) Aditya — can you confirm whether we'll use the redwood-2-small model variant or a community LLM variant for pilot? Any quantization plan?

If the Dedicated pool is not provisioned yet we should mark the timeline as tentative. Otherwise I can take the lead and run the kickoff.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: OakBridge activation preflight — owner assignment & blockers

Adding technical details from the discovery notes:
- Expected steady-state: ~40 qps, burst to 200 qps for short windows (peak clinician shift change).
- Model for pilot: redwood-2-small (quantized int8) to balance latency/cost. We'll propose a fallback to a smaller variant for degraded capacity.
- Auth: We'll provision a test API key scoped to a sandbox project; production keys issued once SOW milestones 1 & 2 are met.
- Data ingestion: OakBridge will SFTP CSVs to our intake bucket; sample-schema.csv attached. Please confirm column names for PHI flags — they plan to supply de-identified records, but we still need mapping.

Sample curl for test env (replace TEST_KEY):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","input":"Summarize patient note: ..."}'

I'll also pre-seed the preflight template with the expected endpoints and a first-pass capacity recommendation. If Security needs our SOC 2 evidence, I can attach the doc to the shared Drive link.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: sample-schema.csv
